connector.name: Aibooma - AI Agent Registry
connector.registryDescription: AI agent registry - search, discover, register, and connect agents via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.aibooma.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.aibooma. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Aibooma account API key (aibk_...) for agent registration and management. Not required for search and discovery.
